claim_text: The NF1 gene spans the breakpoint of a t(1;17) translocation mutation, as confirmed by mapping of NF1 cDNA clones.
source_title: The neurofibromatosis type 1 gene encodes a protein related to GAP
notes: Full text unavailable (not in PMC), extracted from abstract. Strength capped at 3: sequence-similarity evidence, no biochemical GAP assay in this paper. DOI: 10.1016/0092-8674(90)90024-9 (omitted from source_doi because schema oneOf rejects pmid+doi together). | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB (kg2cploverdb.transltr.io) and SRI Node Normalizer (nodenormalization-sri.renci.org), accessed 2026-11-17. NF1 gene=NCBIGene:4763. The t(1;17) translocation is a cytogenetic variant that disrupts NF1; no canonical CURIE exists in standard ontologies (checked RTX-KG2, ClinVar, HGVS). Using provisional ID HGNC:karyotype:t(1;17). This translocation was used as a mapping tool to localize NF1 on 17q11.2. Recommend Kim flag this node as needing manual curation for a stable identifier. | Re-grounded 2026-11-27 for issue #88: ASSOCIATED_WITH replaced with v2.0 Biolink predicate. ASSOCIATED_WITH -> GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION. Note: object is a cytogenetic variant (provisional CURIE), not a standard Disease/Phenotype. Claim remains rejected.
rejection_reason: Multiple structural issues: (1) No standard CURIE exists for cytogenetic variant t(1;17) — HGNC:karyotype: is non-standard; (2) ASSOCIATED_WITH from Gene to karyotype object not permitted by edge_constraints; (3) related_nodes Protein entry not relevant to this genomic mapping claim. Needs: cytogenetic variant node type or Mutation node with hgvs_cdna notation, plus correct edge type.
